امریکہ کے محکمہ انصاف کی جاری کردہ دستاویزات سے یہ بھی معلوم ہوا کہ سزا کے باوجود اس ماڈلنگ ایجنسی سے جڑی 10 ماڈلز نے ایپسٹین سے ملاقاتیں کیں، جبکہ ایپسٹین نے سنہ 2005 میں اس ایجنسی کو 10 لاکھ ڈالر کا عطیہ بھی دیا تھا۔ ان فائلوں میں دیگر افراد جیسے رامسی الخولی اور فیتھ کیٹس کے تعلقات کا بھی ذکر ہے، جن پر سابقہ تحقیقات میں کوئی فرد جرم عائد نہیں کی گئی۔

اس معاملے پر نیویارک سٹیٹ کے سینیٹر زیلنر مائری نے محکمہ انصاف کے موقف کو چیلنج کرتے ہوئے ایک بل پیش کیا ہے جس کا مقصد قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کو ایپسٹین کے معاونین کی تحقیقات کے لیے مزید اختیارات دینا ہے۔ ماڈل الائنس کی بانی سارا زِف نے بھی اس بات کی تائید کی ہے کہ ماڈلنگ ایجنسیاں ہی ماڈلز اور استحصال کرنے والوں کے درمیان رابطے کا بنیادی ذریعہ بنتی ہیں۔

سنہ 2019 میں ایپسٹین کی دوسری گرفتاری کے بعد 'ایم سی ٹو' ایجنسی کو بند کر دیا گیا تھا، تاہم جیف فلر نے 'دی سورس ماڈلز' کے نام سے نئی ایجنسی قائم کر لی جس میں سابقہ 50 ماڈلز کو منتقل کر دیا گیا۔ ایپسٹین کے متاثرین کی وکیل سِگریڈ میک کاولی کا کہنا ہے کہ ماڈلز کی تلاش کرنے والے افراد اس استحصالی نظام میں کلیدی حیثیت رکھتے تھے کیونکہ ایپسٹین کو روزانہ متعدد لڑکیوں کی ضرورت ہوتی تھی۔

stories.title: BJP criticizes Sonia Gandhi over new memoir ahead of elections
stories.summary:
India's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party has strongly criticized opposition leader Sonia Gandhi regarding her newly published memoir, titled "Belonging." Released on Tuesday, the book chronicles her life from studying in England and meeting Rajiv Gandhi to her involvement in the Nehru-Gandhi political dynasty. BJP spokesperson C.R. Kesavan accused the 79-year-old author of attempting to whitewash historical wrongdoings associated with the Congress party and sugar-coat past events.

Among the historical episodes highlighted by the BJP spokesperson are the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, which resulted in nearly 3,000 deaths following the assassination of prime minister Indira Gandhi by Sikh bodyguards. In her writing, Sonia describes this period as shameful and tragic while defending her husband Rajiv against allegations of complicity. The BJP also targeted her portrayal of the 21-month state of Emergency imposed by Indira Gandhi in 1975, which saw the suspension of civil liberties, press censorship, and the imprisonment of political opponents.

Congress leaders responded by alleging that Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party is manufacturing a spectacle and applying a political spin to the publication. Although Sonia has not directly addressed the criticism, her book's prologue notes that it functions as a personal memoir framed against a backdrop of politics. The text has achieved commercial success, topping Amazon India's bestseller list on Wednesday at a price of $14.

The timing of the book's release coincides with significant political tension in India, as the Congress party leads protests against the Modi government over voter list revisions ahead of crucial state elections in Uttar Pradesh and Punjab. The debate surrounding the memoir has divided public opinion on social media and generated extensive coverage across national newspapers.

stories.title: پشاور ہائیکورٹ میں آئینی درخواستوں کی سماعت روکنے پر وفاقی آئینی عدالت میں نظرثانی کی درخواست
stories.summary:
تحریک انصاف کے چیئرمین بیرسٹر گوہر علی خان نے پشاور ہائیکورٹ میں آئینی درخواستوں کی سماعت روکنے کے عدالتی معاملے پر وفاقی آئینی عدالت میں ایک اہم درخواست دائر کی ہے۔ یہ آئینی درخواست وکلاء شاہ فیصل الیاس ایڈووکیٹ اور علی زمان ایڈووکیٹ کے توسط سے جمع کروائی گئی ہے۔ اس درخواست کا بنیادی مقصد پشاور ہائیکورٹ میں زیرِ سماعت مقدمے میں فریق بننا اور اپنا مؤقف پیش کرنا ہے۔

درخواست گزار کی جانب سے مؤقف اختیار کیا گیا ہے کہ رواں سال پانچ نومبر کے عدالتی حکم نامے کی وجہ سے پشاور ہائیکورٹ میں زیرِ سماعت آئینی درخواستوں کی کارروائی شدید متاثر ہوئی ہے۔ اس صورتحال کے پیش نظر وفاقی آئینی عدالت سے باضابطہ استدعا کی گئی ہے کہ وہ اپنے پانچ نومبر کے حکم پر نظرِثانی کرے تاکہ پشاور ہائیکورٹ کو قانون اور آئین کے مطابق زیرِ التوا آئینی درخواستوں کی سماعت جاری رکھنے اور فیصلے صادر کرنے کی اجازت مل سکے۔

مزید برآں، درخواست میں یہ زور بھی دیا گیا ہے کہ اس عدالتی نظرثانی سے عام شہریوں کے بنیادی حقوق کے تحفظ کو یقینی بنایا جا سکے گا اور انہیں انصاف تک آسان رسائی فراہم کی جا سکے گی۔ یہ معاملہ عدالتی کارروائی اور بنیادی حقوق کے تحفظ کے تناظر میں کافی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

stories.title: سجاول میں سرکاری ایمبولینس کے خفیہ خانوں سے منشیات برآمد
stories.summary:
سندھ کے ضلع سجاول میں پولیس نے ایک کارروائی کے دوران سرکاری ایمبولینس کے خفیہ خانوں سے بڑی مقدار میں منشیات اور مضرِ صحت گٹکا برآمد کر لیا ہے۔ پولیس کے مطابق یہ کارروائی ایک مشکوک ایمبولینس کی تلاشی کے دوران عمل میں لائی گئی۔

ابتدائی تفتیش سے یہ بات سامنے آئی ہے کہ ملزمان نے یہ منشیات اور گٹکا کراچی کے علاقے موچکو سے خریدا تھا اور اسے سرکاری ایمبولینس کا غلط استعمال کرتے ہوئے سجاول منتقل کیا جا رہا تھا۔

پولیس نے موقع پر کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ایمبولینس کے ڈرائیور کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔ گرفتار ملزم کی شناخت نواب شاہ کے رہائشی آصف کے نام سے ہوئی ہے۔

سجاول تھانے میں ملزم کے خلاف باضابطہ مقدمہ درج کر کے مزید تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے تاکہ اس مکروہ دھندے میں ملوث دیگر افراد کا بھی سراغ لگایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کا کوہاٹ میں دہشتگرد حملے میں پولیس اہلکاروں کی شہادت پر اظہارِ افسوس
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے کوہاٹ کے علاقے دارہ بکاخ میں دہشت گرد حملے کے نتیجے میں خیبرپختونخوا پولیس کے 10 اہلکاروں کی شہادت پر گہرے دکھ اور افسوس کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ وزیراعظم نے حملے کی شدید مذمت کرتے ہوئے دہشت گردوں کے خلاف بہادری سے لڑتے ہوئے جامِ شہادت نوش کرنے والے ڈپٹی سپرنٹنڈنٹ آف پولیس حیدر زمان سمیت تمام شہداء کو خراجِ عقیدت پیش کیا۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ خیبرپختونخوا پولیس کے بہادر افسران اور جوانوں نے جانوں کا نذرانہ پیش کر کے فرض شناسی اور جرأت کی عظیم مثال قائم کی ہے اور وہ قوم کے ہیرو ہیں۔

وزیراعظم نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ دہشت گردوں کے خلاف کارروائی میں 18 خوارج کو ہلاک کرنا پولیس کی پیشہ ورانہ صلاحیتوں اور غیر متزلزل عزم کا مظہر ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ جرائم پیشہ عناصر اور فتنہ الخوارج کا گٹھ جوڑ ملک میں بدامنی پھیلانے کی مذموم کوشش ہے جسے کسی صورت کامیاب نہیں ہونے دیا جائے گا۔ شہباز شریف نے کہا کہ دہشت گردی کے خلاف جنگ میں پولیس اور دیگر قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے اہلکار جس جرأت سے فرائض انجام دے رہے ہیں وہ لائقِ تحسین ہے۔

وزیراعظم نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ پوری قوم اپنی سیکیورٹی فورسز اور قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے شانہ بشانہ کھڑی ہے اور پاکستان کے امن و استحکام پر کوئی سمجھوتہ نہیں کیا جائے گا۔ حکومت ملک سے دہشت گردی کے عفریت کے مکمل خاتمے کے لیے پُرعزم ہے۔

واضح رہے کہ کوہاٹ میں پولیس اہلکار غیر قانونی گولڈ مائننگ کے خلاف ایک گرینڈ آپریشن کے دوران شہید ہوئے، اور اس کیس کی مکمل تفتیش کاؤنٹر ٹیررزم ڈیپارٹمنٹ (سی ٹی ڈی) کے سپرد کی گئی ہے۔ اس سانحے کے بعد شہداء کی نماز جنازہ ادا کی گئی جس میں گورنر خیبرپختونخوا سمیت اعلیٰ حکام نے شرکت کی۔

stories.title: Pakistan's new auto policy focuses on exports and domestic manufacturing
stories.summary:
Pakistan's newly announced Auto and Auto Parts Manufacturing Policy for 2026-2031 aims to transition the automotive sector from import-dependent assembly toward export-oriented manufacturing and indigenization. Haroon Akhtar Khan, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Industries and Production, outlined these goals during a meeting with ministry officials in Islamabad. He stated that the framework seeks to build a competitive economy by strengthening domestic production and empowering local manufacturers.

The policy establishes mandatory localization requirements designed to ensure that market expansion drives job creation, investment, and technological advancement. Failure to meet minimum domestic value addition targets will incur an additional three percentage points of customs duty on non-localised Completely Knocked Down imports during the following financial year. Additionally, the government has allocated Rs2.1 billion for a dedicated vendor upgradation and technology transfer program, managed by the Engineering Development Board and the Small and Medium Enterprises Development Authority, to support the country's approximately 2,200 auto parts manufacturers.

Export promotion forms a core component of the strategy, setting cumulative export targets of around $6 billion for the five-year period. A tax drawback scheme will provide eligible exporters with a five percent support on net Free on Board export value alongside a ten percent incentive on incremental exports. Furthermore, customs duties are being progressively rationalized over five years, conditioning import concessions—such as a five percent duty on imported battery electric vehicles valued up to $15,000—upon the establishment of domestic manufacturing or assembly facilities backed by financial guarantees.

stories.title: German military bans Chinese drones and restricts vehicles over security fears
stories.summary:
The German military has prohibited the use of Chinese-manufactured drones for training and target practice, opting instead to replace them with domestic and European models. The German defence ministry announced the decision on Wednesday, citing necessary measures to protect data and IT security. According to reports from the news magazine Der Spiegel, the armed forces acted out of concern that Chinese drones could potentially transmit sensitive information regarding military exercises, training grounds, and weapons systems to Chinese intelligence services.

The Bundeswehr previously utilized inexpensive, off-the-shelf commercial drones for basic training with minimal bureaucratic hurdles. Under the new directive, these practices will cease to strengthen technological sovereignty and self-sufficiency. This move aligns with broader European anxieties regarding the deployment of Chinese technologies in sensitive areas, amid continuous warnings from authorities concerning hybrid threats originating from both Russia and China.

In addition to the drone ban, Der Spiegel reported that the Bundeswehr has restricted vehicles produced by Chinese automakers, such as BYD, Geely, and NIO, from entering military barracks and installations. Personnel owning Chinese vehicle models are now required to park them outside facilities and walk inside. While the defence ministry did not explicitly confirm individual car brands on a restricted list, it acknowledged that high-security military zones bar certain vehicle types due to the security risks posed by onboard surveillance sensors like cameras, radar, microphones, and data transmission systems.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to major prisoner swap after Abu Dhabi talks
stories.summary:
Russia's chief negotiator on Ukraine, Vladimir Medinsky, stated on Wednesday that a peace settlement appears closer following two days of discussions in Abu Dhabi. Speaking to Russian state television, Medinsky noted that progress relies heavily on all participating parties, including Ukraine, the United States, and European nations. While Ukrainian and Russian representatives acknowledged some headway, US mediators highlighted persistent trust deficits and ongoing disagreements over territorial issues and Europe's future role in the negotiation process.

Despite the divisions, US envoy Jared Kushner announced that both warring nations agreed to execute their largest-ever humanitarian prisoner release, with exact figures to be finalized shortly. The talks marked the first direct diplomatic engagement between the sides since February. Medinsky expressed skepticism regarding European involvement, stating that Moscow has received no concrete peace proposals from European countries and aiming for a modern version of the 1945 Yalta and Potsdam conferences.

Following the conclusion of the Abu Dhabi sessions, US mediators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner planned to travel to Moscow on Thursday to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Afterward, they intend to fly to Dublin to debrief Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, who is attending European meetings there. Ukrainian chief negotiator Rustem Umerov confirmed that significant differences remain and that difficult work lies ahead, though opportunities to sustain the negotiation process still exist.

stories.title: Pakistan Reports $98.07 Billion in External Public Debt for FY26
stories.summary:
Pakistan repaid approximately $14.44 billion in external loans during the 2025-26 fiscal year, according to the Ministry of Economic Affairs annual report on Foreign Economic Assistance. Total disbursements reached $16.16 billion, missing the budgeted target of $19.92 billion by roughly 19 percent. Borrowing primarily supported the balance of payments, fiscal imbalances, and foreign exchange reserves.

As of June 30, 2026, the country's total external public debt stood at $98.075 billion. Debt servicing for the year totaled $14.436 billion, comprising $11.198 billion in principal repayments and $3.238 billion in interest payments. Net transfers amounted to $4.417 billion, contributing to an overall public debt increase of about $6.28 billion, or 6.84 percent, compared to $91.795 billion at the end of the previous fiscal year.

Disbursements for budgetary support and balance of payments reached $9.375 billion, bolstered by contributions from Naya Pakistan Certificates, time deposits from friendly countries, commercial banks, bonds, and the International Monetary Fund. Project financing accounted for $3.435 billion, targeting energy, power, environment, climate resilience, water, transport, and education sectors. Program financing and commodity financing also contributed to the overall inflows.

Multilateral and bilateral development partners provided $59.931 billion of the total external debt. New financing commitments agreed during the period totaled $8.951 billion, with the World Bank, Asian Development Bank, and Islamic Development Bank serving as the largest multilateral contributors. Saudi Arabia and China led bilateral contributions. The funding matters for managing the nation's fiscal stability and ongoing economic development programs.

stories.title: بالی ووڈ اداکارہ کرینہ کپور کو دیوالی پر قرآنی آیت والا ہار پہننے پر نوٹس
stories.summary:
بالی ووڈ کی مشہور اداکارہ کرینہ کپور کو دیوالی کی تقریبات کے دوران آیت کریمہ کندہ زیورات پہننے کی وجہ سے باضابطہ طور پر قانونی نوٹس جاری کر دیا گیا ہے۔ بھارتی میڈیا کے مطابق اداکارہ نے دیوالی کے موقع پر اپنے شوہر سیف علی خان کے خاندان سے ورثے میں ملنے والا انتہائی قیمتی زیور پہنا تھا، جس پر قرآن پاک کی بابرکت آیت الکرسی کندہ کی گئی تھی۔ یہ تیس قیراط زمرد کا زیور دراصل بھوپال کے شاہی خاندان کی ملکیت ہے، اور اداکارہ نے اس کے ساتھ تقریباً دو سو سال پرانی کلغی بھی زیب تن کی تھی۔

بھارتی سیاسی رہنما عباس حفیظ نے اس عمل کو مذہبی جذبات مجروح کرنے کے مترادف قرار دیتے ہوئے اداکارہ کرینہ کپور اور ان کی اسٹائلسٹ ریا کپور کو یہ قانونی نوٹس بھجوایا ہے۔ بھیجے گئے نوٹس میں مطالبہ کیا گیا ہے کہ سوشل میڈیا سے اس واقعے سے متعلق تمام تصاویر اور ویڈیوز کو فوری طور پر ہٹایا جائے، عوامی سطح پر غیر مشروط معافی مانگی جائے اور آئندہ سے مقدس آیات کا مکمل احترام یقینی بنایا جائے۔

شکایت کنندہ عباس حفیظ کا مؤقف ہے کہ ان کا اعتراض اداکارہ کے لباس یا دیوالی منانے کے تہوار پر ہرگز نہیں ہے، بلکہ ان کا بنیادی اعتراض قرآنی آیات کو فیشن کے طور پر استعمال کرنے اور پیش کرنے پر ہے۔ تاحال اس قانونی نوٹس کے اجرا کے بعد اداکارہ کرینہ کپور یا سیف علی خان کی جانب سے اس معاملے پر کوئی بھی ردعمل سامنے نہیں آیا ہے۔

stories.title: Shehbaz Sharif Condemns Deadly Kohat Terrorist Attack on Police
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif expressed deep sorrow regarding a terrorist attack in the Darabukach area of Kohat that resulted in the martyrdom of ten Khyber Pakhtunkhwa police personnel, including Deputy Superintendent of Police Haidar Zaman. Speaking on Thursday in an official statement, the prime minister condemned the assault and extended condolences to the families of the fallen officers, praising their bravery and dedication to duty in maintaining national security.

The incident occurred as a police contingent was returning from a joint operation with local administration against illegal gold mining in Darabukach. According to the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police, militants from Fitna al-Khawarij ambushed the returning officers at the instigation of criminal elements. The police fought back vigorously, killing 18 militants during the operation, while twelve other injured officers were transported to a hospital for medical treatment.

Prime Minister Shehbaz emphasized that the cooperation between criminal elements and Fitna al-Khawarij represents a malicious effort to create national unrest, which the government will strictly prevent. He highlighted that the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police have made unmatched sacrifices in counter-terrorism efforts and reiterated that the government remains fully resolved to eliminate terrorism without compromise.

This event unfolds amid a sharp surge in cross-border militant violence, particularly affecting Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan following the return of the Afghan Taliban to power in 2021. Data from the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies indicated that September 2026 recorded the highest monthly count of militant attacks in 12 years. Islamabad continues to urge Kabul to prevent Afghan territory from being used for anti-Pakistan attacks.

stories.title: South Korea Sees Unlikely US-North Korea Contact Ahead of APEC
stories.summary:
South Korea's presidential office announced that expectations for contact between the United States and North Korea around the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China are very low. Officials also noted that Pyongyang's participation in APEC-related events remains unlikely, dampening hopes for bilateral or multilateral diplomatic breakthroughs this year despite past interest from US President Donald Trump in restarting talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

Tensions along the inter-Korean border have recently escalated, driven by a spike in cross-border disputes and security incidents. Seoul reported that a landmine blast in September, which seriously injured several South Korean soldiers, was caused by mines planted by North Korea during Demilitarized Zone fortification activities. Pyongyang has denied responsibility, labeling the accusation a fabrication by South Korea.

Adding to the regional strain, North Korean official Kim Yo Jong announced plans to potentially restart loudspeaker propaganda broadcasts near the border. Despite these developments, a senior South Korean presidential official stated that no unusual North Korean military activity beyond loudspeaker preparations has been detected at the DMZ.

Seoul is also closely monitoring the potential attendance of Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Shenzhen summit to address diplomatic matters with Moscow. Officials suggest that a possible trilateral meeting involving the United States, China, and Russia could offer a platform to discuss North Korean issues. These developments matter for regional security and diplomatic stability in East Asia.

stories.title: US Dollar Reaches 19-Month High Amid Federal Reserve Rate Hike Expectations
stories.summary:
The US dollar climbed to a 19-month high against major currencies, driven by escalating expectations of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike following stronger-than-expected October inflation data. Market participants adjusted their outlooks after several hawkish remarks from US central bank officials, who expressed concern over persistent inflation and left open the possibility of a 50-basis-point increase. Major brokerages, including Goldman Sachs, anticipate additional tightening early next year.

The dollar index, which tracks the greenback against a basket of currencies, rose 0.15 percent to 103.02, marking its highest level since April 2025. Attention has turned toward upcoming commentary from New York Fed President John Williams to gauge the central bank's shifting stance on monetary policy following the hotter-than-forecast consumer price index report.

Meanwhile, the Japanese yen weakened toward the key level of 160 per dollar, supported by wide interest-rate differentials. Bank of Japan board member Toichiro Asada pushed back against near-term rate hike calls, warning that premature tightening could harm economic growth and underlying inflation. However, data showing Japan's annual wholesale inflation re-accelerating to 7.1 percent in October has kept expectations alive for a potential BOJ rate hike as early as next month.

Other major currencies saw minor shifts, with the euro rising slightly against the greenback while sterling experienced a slight decline. In cryptocurrency markets, both bitcoin and ether traded lower. These currency fluctuations and shifting monetary policy bets matter for global trade balances and international financial markets.

stories.title: عمران خان سے ملاقات کو پسِ پردہ ڈیل سے جوڑنا مضحکہ خیز پروپیگنڈا ہے
stories.summary:
گزشتہ روز اڈیالہ جیل میں ہونے والی ملاقات کو کسی بھی قسم کی خفیہ سیاسی سرگرمی یا پسِ پردہ ڈیل قرار دینا محض ایک قیاس آرائی اور جھوٹا پروپیگنڈا ہے۔ دستیاب رپورٹس کے مطابق اسلام آباد ہائی کورٹ نے خود وکلاء کو قیدی سے ملاقات کرنے کی باقاعدہ اجازت دی تھی تاکہ زیرِ سماعت مقدمات، اپیلوں اور دیگر قانونی امور کے حوالے سے ضروری بات چیت کی جا سکے۔

ملاقات میں شامل قانون دان سلمان صفدر اور لطیف کھوسہ دونوں ہی قیدی کے باضابطہ قانونی نمائندے ہیں، اور اپنے مؤکل سے مشاورت کرنا عدالت کے حکم کے عین مطابق تھا۔ اس لیے اس قانونی اور عدالتی عمل کو کسی بھی قسم کی سیاسی مفاہمت، ڈیل یا خفیہ منصوبہ بندی کا نام دینا سراسر جھوٹ اور مضحکہ خیز ہے۔

حاصل کلام یہ ہے کہ اس معاملے میں کسی قسم کا کوئی بیک ڈور چینل فعال نہیں ہے۔ اگر اس طرح کی ملاقاتوں پر بھی تحریک انصاف کی جانب سے سیاست چمکانے کی کوشش کی گئی تو اس کا حتمی نقصان صرف اور صرف متعلقہ قیدی کو ہی اٹھانا پڑے گا۔

stories.title: الیکشن کمیشن نے انٹرا پارٹی انتخابات نہ ہونے پر ایم کیو ایم پاکستان کا سربراہ عہدہ خالی قرار دے دیا
stories.summary:
الیکشن کمیشن آف پاکستان کی جانب سے رجسٹرڈ سیاسی جماعتوں کی نئی فہرست جاری کی گئی ہے جس کے بعد ایم کیو ایم پاکستان کی مشکلات میں نمایاں اضافہ ہو گیا ہے۔ الیکشن کمیشن نے وقت پر انٹرا پارٹی انتخابات منعقد نہ کروانے کی پاداش میں ایم کیو ایم پاکستان کے سربراہ کا عہدہ باضابطہ طور پر خالی قرار دے دیا ہے، جس کے بعد نئی جاری کردہ فہرست میں سے پارٹی سربراہ کا نام بھی مکمل طور پر حذف کر دیا گیا ہے۔

واضح رہے کہ الیکشن کمیشن نے ایم کیو ایم پاکستان کو انٹرا پارٹی انتخابات کے انعقاد کے لیے رواں سال اکتوبر تک کی مہلت فراہم کی تھی۔ مقررہ وقت اور دی گئی ڈیڈ لائن ختم ہونے کے بعد الیکشن کمیشن کی جانب سے متعلقہ جماعت کو باضابطہ طور پر شو کاز نوٹس بھی جاری کیا گیا تھا جس پر بروقت عمل درآمد نہ ہو سکا۔

یاد رہے کہ الیکشن کمیشن کی جانب سے جاری کی جانے والی اس نئی سیاسی فہرست میں دیگر بڑی جماعتیں بھی شامل ہیں۔ اس فہرست کے اندر پاکستان تحریک انصاف اور تحریک لبیک پاکستان کے نام بھی بغیر کسی سربراہ کے درج کیے گئے ہیں۔

اس پیشرفت کے بعد ملک کی سیاسی فضا میں ہلچل مچ گئی ہے اور تمام سیاسی حلقوں کی نظریں الیکشن کمیشن کے ان اقدامات اور سیاسی جماعتوں کے آئندہ لائحہ عمل پر مرکوز ہیں۔ سیاسی جماعتوں کے لیے انٹرا پارٹی انتخابات کا انعقاد الیکشن کمیشن کے قوانین کے تحت لازمی قرار دیا جاتا ہے۔

stories.title: محکمہ موسمیات نے کراچی میں مغربی ہواؤں کے زیر اثر ہلکی بارش کی پیشگوئی کر دی
stories.summary:
محکمہ موسمیات کے ارلی وارننگ سینٹر کی جانب سے جاری کردہ پیشگوئی کے مطابق کراچی میں مغربی ہواؤں کا سلسلہ داخل ہو رہا ہے جس کے زیر اثر شہر کا مطلع کل جزوی طور پر ابرآلود رہنے کی توقع ہے۔ ان مغربی ہواؤں کے اثرات کے تحت شہر قائد میں ہلکی بارش اور ہلکی بوندا باندی کا بھی امکان ظاہر کیا گیا ہے۔

محکمہ موسمیات کا کہنا ہے کہ ملک کے مغربی اور بالائی حصوں کو ایک نئی مغربی ہواؤں کی لہر متاثر کر رہی ہے، جس کے باعث کراچی کے ساتھ ساتھ جمعے کے روز سندھ کے دیگر مقامات پر بھی ہلکی بارش ہو سکتی ہے۔ ان مقامات میں جامشورو، ٹھٹھہ، قمبر شہداد کوٹ اور داود کے علاقے شامل ہیں۔

کراچی میں ہلکی بارش اور بوندا باندی کے بعد شہر کا موسم تبدیل ہونے کا امکان ہے۔ پیشگوئی کے مطابق اس ہلکی بارش اور بوندا باندی کے بعد شہر میں سرد ہوائیں چل سکتی ہیں جس سے خنکی میں اضافہ ہو گا۔

مجموعی طور پر صوبے کے بیشتر علاقوں میں موسم خشک جبکہ راتوں کے وقت خنک رہنے کی توقع ظاہر کی گئی ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ محکمہ موسمیات نے خبردار کیا ہے کہ صوبے کے میدانی علاقوں میں صبح کے اوقات میں دھند بھی چھائی رہ سکتی ہے۔

stories.title: Nvidia Shares Plunge as Board Considers CEO Jensen Huang's Future
stories.summary:
Global stock markets experienced a cautious start in Asian trade, while Nvidia shares plummeted in after-hours trading following reports that its board of directors would meet to decide the fate of longtime Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. The emergency meeting was prompted by allegations that Huang had an affair with a company executive reporting directly to him who was suspected of being a spy for China. The situation has raised significant governance and leadership concerns for the dominant artificial intelligence processor manufacturer.

Industry analysts noted that while the scandal presents severe reputational risks, Huang remains a central figure in the artificial intelligence sector. Market observers suggest the board is unlikely to remove him without securing a high-profile replacement in the technology industry. Following the news, Nvidia shares fell more than 8 percent after the bell, pulling S&P 500 e-mini futures down by 0.4 percent.

Despite the turmoil surrounding Nvidia, regional stock indexes in Asia showed mixed resilience. South Korean, Taiwanese, and Japanese equities posted modest gains, while Hong Kong shares weighed down broader regional benchmarks. On Wall Street, equities had previously advanced due to optimism surrounding artificial intelligence developments involving firms like CoreWeave and Anthropic.

Concurrently, the US dollar remained steady at a high level against major currencies as traders priced in a strong likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike at the upcoming December meeting. Cryptocurrency assets, including bitcoin and ether, recorded slight declines during the session. These concurrent developments matter for investor confidence across global technology and financial sectors.

stories.title: یوٹیوبر اقرا کنول نے انکشاف کیا کہ ایوارڈ شو انتظامیہ نے کیٹیگریز کے تنازع پر غلطی مان لی
stories.summary:
پاکستان کی معروف اور مقبول یوٹیوبر اقرا کنول نے حالیہ ایوارڈ شو کے دوران پیش آنے والے تنازعے کے حوالے سے ایک اہم انکشاف کیا ہے۔ سوشل میڈیا پر وائرل ہونے والی ایک ویڈیو میں انہوں نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ اس ایوارڈ شو کی انتظامی ٹیم نے اپنی غلطی کو تسلیم کر لیا ہے۔

اقرا کنول کے مطابق ایوارڈ شو کی انتظامیہ نے اعتراف کیا ہے کہ مختلف کیٹیگریز کو حتمی شکل دینے کے پورے عمل کے دوران ان سے غلطی سرزد ہوئی تھی۔ اس تمام معاملے اور کیٹیگریز کے تعین میں ہونے والی غلطی کی وجہ سے ہی سوشل میڈیا پر تنازع پیدا ہوا تھا۔

یہ تنازع اس وقت سامنے آیا جب شو کے بعد شائقین اور فنکاروں کی جانب سے مختلف کیٹیگریز اور نامزدگیوں پر سوالات اٹھائے گئے تھے۔ یوٹیوبر کی جانب سے سامنے آنے والے اس بیان نے اس معاملے پر جاری بحث کو ایک نیا رخ دے دیا ہے اور شائقین کی توجہ کا مرکز بن گیا ہے۔

اس انکشاف کے بعد ایوارڈ شو کی انتظامیہ کی طرف سے باضابطہ ردعمل کا انتظار کیا جا رہا ہے، جبکہ سوشل میڈیا صارفین اس معاملے پر مختلف آراء کا اظہار کر رہے ہیں۔ اس نوعیت کے تنازعات اکثر شوبز حلقوں میں بحث کا موضوع بنتے ہیں۔

stories.title: Foreign Inflows Counter Strong Dollar to Support Indian Rupee
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee is expected to open largely flat, trading within the 93.68 to 93.74 range after closing at 93.69 against the dollar on Wednesday, marking its strongest level since April. This stability comes as robust foreign equity inflows counterbalance a strengthening US dollar, which has recently reached a one-month high.

Foreign investors poured $1.34 billion into Indian equities on Wednesday, bringing month-to-date inflows close to $8 billion. This marks a significant reversal in market sentiment. Previously, foreign investors had withdrawn over $30 billion from Indian equities throughout the year, driven by fears of tighter US restrictions on artificial intelligence data-centre construction following the Democratic Party election win. These concerns unsettled the AI trade and prompted investors to reduce exposure to semiconductor-heavy markets in favor of India as a diversification option.

The currency has also found support from declining oil prices, with Brent crude hovering around $92 a barrel down from $118 less than two weeks prior. These tailwinds reinforce the Reserve Bank of India's efforts to stabilize the exchange rate, though currency traders remain watchful regarding the durability of the turnaround.

Meanwhile, the dollar index remained near a one-month high in Asian trading. This was driven by increasing expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike following stronger-than-expected October inflation figures and hawkish statements from US central bank officials, posing ongoing resistance to the rupee.

stories.title: انٹرنیشنل جونیئر اسکواش کھلاڑی ماہ نور علی کی وزیراعظم اور فیلڈ مارشل سے انصاف کی اپیل
stories.summary:
پشاور سے تعلق رکھنے والی 14 سالہ بین الاقوامی جونیئر اسکواش کھلاڑی اور علی سسٹرز کی رکن ماہ نور علی نے وزیر اعظم پاکستان اور فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر سے شدید مالی مشکلات کے پیشِ نظر فوری انصاف کی اپیل کی ہے۔ ماہ نور علی کا کہنا ہے کہ وہ پوری محنت سے دنیا بھر میں پاکستان کا پرچم بلند کر رہی ہیں، انہوں نے ایشین جونیئر سپر سیریز میں چار مرتبہ گولڈ میڈل جیتے ہیں اور گزشتہ و رواں برس دو مرتبہ ایشین جونیئر چیمپئن شپ کے فائنل تک بھی رسائی حاصل کی ہے۔

کم عمر کھلاڑی نے افسوس کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ اتنی بڑی بین الاقوامی کامیابیوں کے باوجود وہ اب تک اپنی جائز پرائز منی اور انعامی رقم سے محروم ہیں۔ انہوں نے الزام عائد کیا کہ اس حق کو حاصل کرنے کے لیے انہوں نے پاکستان اسپورٹس بورڈ اور صدر پاکستان اسپورٹس بورڈ کے دفتر کے ان گنت چکر لگائے ہیں لیکن تاحال انہیں ان کا جائز حق فراہم نہیں کیا گیا۔

ماہ نور علی نے مزید وضاحت کی کہ موجودہ شدید مالی بحران اور وسائل کی کمی کی وجہ سے اب ان کے لیے بین الاقوامی مقابلوں میں پاکستان کی نمائندگی کرنا، سفر کرنا، ٹریننگ اور دیگر تمام اخراجات اٹھانا انتہائی مشکل تر ہوتا جا رہا ہے۔ ان کا ماننا ہے کہ اگر ملک کے باصلاحیت نوجوان کھلاڑیوں کو ان کی محنت کا صلہ اور حکومتی سرپرستی نہیں ملے گی تو آنے والے وقت میں کوئی بھی اس کھیل کو اپنانے کی زحمت نہیں کرے گا۔

انہوں نے پرزور مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ ان کی جائز انعامی رقم کی فوری ادائیگی کے احکامات جاری کیے جائیں اور ساتھ ہی مالی معاونت بھی فراہم کی جائے تاکہ وہ مزید میڈلز جیت سکیں۔ ماہ نور علی نے اپیل کی ہے کہ ملک کے اس قیمتی ٹیلنٹ کو ضائع ہونے سے بچایا جائے اور ان کی آواز سنی جائے۔

stories.title: Indian Shares Set for Muted Opening After Recent Foreign-Led Rally
stories.summary:
Indian equities are anticipated to open flat on Thursday as benchmark indexes consolidate following a significant rally propelled by continuous foreign capital inflows, declining crude oil prices, and a cooling global artificial intelligence trade. GIFT Nifty futures stood at 25,270 at 8:00 a.m. IST, pointing toward a subdued start for the Nifty 50 index, which closed at 25,255.05 on Wednesday to reach an eight-month closing high.

Foreign portfolio investors purchased 125.63 billion rupees, or $1.34 billion, worth of domestic shares on Wednesday, according to provisional figures. Their net purchases for November have reached $6.43 billion, marking their largest monthly buying spree since September 2024. These strong investments have driven the Nifty 50 and Sensex indexes up by 9.6% and 10% respectively during November, reversing a two-year period where Indian shares lagged behind emerging-market peers due to high oil prices and limited exposure to global AI-driven rallies.

Meanwhile, Brent crude futures declined over 1% to $91.8 per barrel amid optimism regarding potential progress in Middle East and Russia-Ukraine peace negotiations. Hariselvan Radhakrishnan, founder and chief executive of HST Wealth, noted that while lower crude prices offer support, the US 10-year Treasury yield remaining near 4.99% and the extended market rally might limit immediate gains. Across the wider region, MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan dropped 0.1% due to weakness in Hong Kong equities.

Additionally, index provider MSCI added Adani Green Energy, Coforge, Life Insurance Corporation of India, and Meesho to the MSCI India index while removing PI Industries. These index adjustments are expected to bring specific attention to the newly included company shares as trading commences.

stories.title: Global Oil Prices Fall Past One Dollar on Peace Talks Hope
stories.summary:
Crude oil prices declined by more than one dollar on Thursday as expectations of headway in Middle East and Russia-Ukraine peace talks eased market pressures, despite lingering geopolitical tensions and new supply data. Brent futures decreased by $1.14, or 1.2%, reaching $91.62 a barrel by 0141 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude futures dropped $1.04, or 1.2%, to $85.49. These drops followed modest gains on Wednesday when Brent rose about 1.4% and WTI 0.6% after hitting two-month lows earlier in the week.

Hiroyuki Kikukawa, chief strategist at Nissan Securities Investment, stated that markets are retreating due to anticipation of backdoor efforts toward a Russia-Ukraine ceasefire and the unlikeliness of an escalation in the Iran conflict before the upcoming US-China summit next week. Kikukawa added that persistent uncertainties around the Strait of Hormuz mean markets are unlikely to experience a severe collapse. During peace talks in Abu Dhabi concluding on Wednesday, Russian and Ukrainian negotiators agreed on a major prisoner exchange, though US mediators indicated deep differences remain on issues such as territory, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy expressed hope for concrete results this year.

In the Middle East, Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei stated in televised remarks that Iran will not surrender any enriched nuclear material and warned of consequences if the US launches fresh strikes. Washington maintains that nuclear issues must form part of initial negotiations to end the eight-month-old conflict, even as US officials downplay the necessity of further military action. Concurrently, OPEC+ crude production rose in October, driven largely by increased output from Saudi Arabia despite shipping disruptions through the Hormuz Strait.

Market sources reported that US crude inventories expanded by 9 million barrels over the latest week, based on data from the American Petroleum Institute. Official figures from the US Energy Information Administration are scheduled for release on Thursday, delayed by one day following a US national holiday on Wednesday.

stories.title: ایران جنگ کے خاتمے کی سفارتی کوششیں، جے ڈی وینس کی ایرانی قیادت سے ملاقات کا امکان
stories.summary:
امریکی نائب صدر جے ڈی وینس کی جانب سے جاری ایران جنگ کو ختم کرنے کے لیے ایرانی قدامت پسند قیادت سے براہِ راست ملاقات پر غور کیا جا رہا ہے۔ امریکی میڈیا رپورٹس کے مطابق اس ممکنہ ملاقات کا بنیادی مقصد تنازع کے خاتمے کی خاطر سفارتی راستوں کی تلاش ہے۔ تاہم اب تک اس ملاقات کی کوئی بھی حتمی تاریخ، طے شدہ مقام یا اس میں شریک ہونے والے کسی بھی ایرانی رہنما کے نام سے متعلق تفصیلات عوام کے سامنے نہیں آئی ہیں۔

دوسری جانب امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ بھی ایران کے ساتھ مذاکرات کی بحالی پر اپنی آمادگی ظاہر کر چکے ہیں۔ صدر ٹرمپ کا اس حوالے سے کہنا ہے کہ انہوں نے اس تمام معاملے پر نائب صدر جے ڈی وینس کو ضروری اختیارات تفویض کر دیے ہیں۔ امریکی میڈیا کی ان اطلاعات کے بعد جاری ایران جنگ کے خاتمے کے لیے براہِ راست سفارتی رابطوں کے امکانات پر توجہ میں نمایاں اضافہ ہو چکا ہے۔

تاہم فی الحال اس بات کی کوئی باضابطہ تصدیق نہیں ہوئی ہے کہ جے ڈی وینس اور ایرانی قیادت کے درمیان ملاقات کے حوالے سے کوئی حتمی فیصلہ کیا گیا ہو۔ امریکی میڈیا رپورٹس میں یہ واضح کیا گیا ہے کہ اس ممکنہ ملاقات کے حوالے سے فی الحال کسی قسم کا باضابطہ اعلان سامنے نہیں آیا ہے اور معاملات ابھی زیرِ غور ہیں۔

یہ پیشرفت ایسے وقت میں سامنے آئی ہے جب خطے میں کشیدگی کو کم کرنے اور جنگ کے خاتمے کے لیے مختلف سطح پر سفارتی کوششیں کی جا رہی ہیں۔ دونوں ممالک کے درمیان براہِ راست رابطوں کی اطلاعات نے بین الاقوامی سطح پر مبصرین کی توجہ حاصل کی ہے، جو اسے تنازع کے حل کی طرف ایک اہم قدم قرار دے رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: پاکستانی نژاد برطانوی ڈاکٹر آصف حسن کو لائف ٹائم اچیومنت ایوارڈ سے نوازا گیا
stories.summary:
برطانیہ کے فری مین ہسپتال نیوکاسل سے منسلک معروف پاکستانی نژاد ہارٹ سرجن ڈاکٹر آصف حسن کو بچوں کی ہارٹ سرجری کے شعبے میں گراں قدر خدمات پر پرائیڈ آف برٹن ایوارڈز میں لائف ٹائم اچیومنٹ ایوارڈ سے نوازا گیا۔ تقریب کے دوران سابقہ مریض بچوں کی موجودگی نے تقریب کو انتہائی جذباتی بنا دیا، جہاں ڈاکٹر آصف بھی اپنے جذبات پر قابو نہ رکھ سکے۔ ڈاکٹر آصف 1956 میں کراچی میں پیدا ہوئے، انھوں نے 1979 میں ڈاؤ میڈیکل کالج سے ایم بی بی ایس کیا اور بعد ازاں برطانیہ منتقل ہو گئے۔ انھوں نے اپنے 35 سالہ طویل کیریئر کے دوران 4 ہزار سے زائد ہارٹ آپریشنز اور 400 سے زیادہ ٹرانسپلانٹس کیے۔

ڈاکٹر آصف نے بچوں کی ہارٹ سرجری اور ٹرانسپلانٹس میں مہارت حاصل کی اور کم عمر بچوں میں بڑے دل کے کامیاب ٹرانسپلانٹس کی نئی تکنیکیں متعارف کروائیں۔ اپنے ایک انٹرویو میں انھوں نے سسلیا نامی بچی کے مشکل کیس کا ذکر کیا، جس کی عمر آٹھ سال اور وزن 20 کلوگرام تھا، جبکہ اسے 90 کلوگرام وزنی شخص کا دل کامیابی سے لگایا گیا تھا۔ اس کے علاوہ انھوں نے کئی ماہ کی عمر کے بچوں سے لے کر 18 گھنٹے تک جاری رہنے والے طویل اور پیچیدہ دل اور جگر کے مشترکہ ٹرانسپلانٹس بھی کیے۔

بچوں کے دل کے آپریشنز کی اہمیت اور پیچیدگی کے بارے میں بات کرتے ہوئے ڈاکٹر آصف نے کہا کہ اگرچہ پیدائشی طور پر دل کے امراض کے حامل بچوں کے علاج میں چیلنجز ہوتے ہیں، لیکن میڈیکل سائنس کی ترقی نے ان سرجریز کو اب ایک معیاری عمل بنا دیا ہے۔ انہوں نے اس بات کا بھی ذکر کیا کہ سرجنز کو ناکامیوں کے نفسیاتی اثرات کا سامنا کرنا پڑتا ہے، کیونکہ ہر سرجن کے دل میں ایک قبرستان ہوتا ہے جسے وہ رات کو یاد کرتا ہے۔

ریٹائرمنٹ کے قریب پہنچنے والے ڈاکٹر آصف کے مریضوں اور ان کے والدین کے ساتھ گہرے اور دیرپا تعلقات قائم ہو چکے ہیں۔ تقریب میں ایسے نوجوان بھی شریک ہوئے جن کے وہ دہائیوں پہلے کامیاب آپریشن کر چکے تھے۔ یہ سنگ میل نہ صرف ڈاکٹر آصف اور ان کے خاندان بلکہ برطانیہ میں مقیم پاکستانیوں کے لیے بھی فخر کا باعث بنا، جنھوں نے دنیا بھر میں پاکستان اور برطانوی طبی شعبے کا نام روشن کیا۔

stories.title: Parliament Must Uphold Judicial Independence to Prevent Anarchy, Says Mandokhail
stories.summary:
Outgoing Supreme Court Justice Jamal Khan Mandokhail stated on Wednesday that parliament, representing the sovereign will of the people, must never undermine judicial independence because only an independent judiciary can safeguard fundamental rights. Speaking at a full court reference held in his honor upon retirement, Mandokhail warned that disregarding judicial independence carries severe consequences for the state, lawmakers, and society. He cautioned that when courts bow to political or executive pressure, law is replaced by the arbitrary will of the powerful, creating an environment where dissenters are targeted and systemic corruption or human rights abuses go unchecked, potentially driving citizens to seek alternative justice and leading to anarchy.

Justice Mandokhail emphasized that safeguarding this independence is the shared obligation of parliament, the judiciary, and the executive. He noted that the Constitution establishes boundaries for all state organs and that the judiciary's constitutional role is to keep other branches within their limits through the faithful interpretation of the law. The farewell reference was attended by Chief Justice of Pakistan Yahya Afridi, Attorney General Mansoor Usman Awan, Pakistan Bar Council Vice Chairman Pir Muhammad Masood Chishti, Supreme Court Bar Association President Syed Amjad Shah, alongside senior law officers and members of the legal community.

In his tribute, Chief Justice Afridi praised Justice Mandokhail's judicial career, noting his professional evolution from the bar in Balochistan to the Supreme Court and his contributions to constitutional jurisprudence and institutional growth. CJP Afridi highlighted Mandokhail's tenure as chief justice of the Balochistan High Court, where he strengthened district judiciary infrastructure. The CJP also stressed the importance of maintaining harmony and constructive engagement between the bench and the bar.

Furthermore, CJP Afridi reaffirmed the institutionalization of transparent and uniform procedures through comprehensive standard operating procedures to ensure fairness and accountability. Reiterating the provision of free legal aid at various levels, the Chief Justice emphasized that no individual should be denied legal representation due to financial limitations.

stories.title: عمران خان کی نجی اسپتال منتقلی کا امکان، پی ٹی آئی رہنماؤں کی اہم ملاقات
stories.summary:
تحریک انصاف کے بانی عمران خان کو پمز اسپتال کے بجائے کسی نجی اسپتال منتقل کیے جانے کا امکان ظاہر کیا گیا ہے۔ نجی ٹی وی کی ایک رپورٹ کے مطابق اس سلسلے میں متعلقہ نجی اسپتال کی انتظامیہ کو پہلے ہی مطلع کر دیا گیا ہے، تاہم بانی پی ٹی آئی کو اس اسپتال میں کتنے عرصے کے لیے رکھا جائے گا، اس بارے میں تاحال کوئی حتمی فیصلہ نہیں کیا گیا ہے۔

ذرائع کے مطابق 9 نومبر کو پی ٹی آئی کے رہنماؤں بیرسٹر گوہر، سینیٹر علی ظفر اور سلمان صفدر نے ایک اہم عدالتی شخصیت سے ملاقات کی تھی۔ اس ملاقات میں بنیادی طور پر عمران خان کی صحت اور ان تک رسائی کے معاملے پر تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا تھا۔ اسی نشست کے بعد گزشتہ روز دو وکلا کو بانی پی ٹی آئی سے ملنے کی اجازت دینے کے احکامات جاری کیے گئے تھے۔

رپورٹ کے مطابق گزشتہ رات عمران خان کو پمز اسپتال لے جانے کا فیصلہ بھی اسی رابطے کے بعد سامنے آیا تھا، اور بیرسٹر گوہر خان اس منتقلی کے معاملے سے پہلے ہی آگاہ تھے۔ اب نجی اسپتال منتقلی کے امکان پر بھی پیشرفت جاری ہے، اگرچہ وہاں قیام کی مدت کے بارے میں کچھ کہنا ابھی قبل از وقت ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ، عمران خان کی بہنوں کی رہائی کا معاملہ بھی زیر غور ہونے کا دعویٰ کیا گیا ہے اور ذرائع نے آنے والے دنوں میں ان کی رہائی کا امکان ظاہر کیا ہے۔ بشریٰ بی بی کی طبی صورت حال کے حوالے سے بھی پیشرفت ہوئی ہے اور پروفیسر ڈاکٹر ندیم قریشی کی بیرون ملک سے واپسی کے بعد ان کا مکمل طبی معائنہ کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: Pakistan Hosts Minerals Investment Forum to Attract Global Investors
stories.summary:
Pakistan is hosting the two-day Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum in Islamabad, bringing together international investors and government leaders to promote the nation's vast mineral resources and diversify its export base. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar addressed the gathering, emphasizing that mineral development is now a strategic priority and pointing to Balochistan as vital for copper exploration amid the clean energy transition.

During the event, Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz reported that the province's Mines and Minerals Department revenue increased fourfold from Rs10 billion to Rs40 billion over the past two and a half years. She highlighted Punjab's mineral reserves, which include emeralds, marble, granite, gold, copper, pink salt, and 261.5 million tonnes of iron ore in Chiniot.

To facilitate foreign and domestic investors, Punjab is offering various financial and administrative incentives, including one-window facilitation, concessional land leases, and financing schemes. These include interest-free loans for pink salt value addition, concessional financing up to Rs5 billion, and zero-mark-up or low-interest loans for export-oriented industries.

The provincial government has also established a mineral processing zone in Quaidabad, Khushab, offering land on nominal monthly rent under a 15-year lease with customs duty waivers. Furthermore, administrative procedures such as bidding, work orders, and licensing have been fully digitized and integrated with drone-based monitoring to ensure transparency.

stories.title: امریکی حکام نے پیوٹن سے ایران اور امریکا کے مذاکرات میں ثالثی کی درخواست کی، قالیباف
stories.summary:
ایرانی پارلیمنٹ کے اسپیکر باقر قالیباف نے ایک انٹرویو میں دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ امریکی حکام نے ماسکو کے دورے کے دوران روسی صدر ولادیمیر پیوٹن سے ایران اور امریکا کے درمیان مذاکرات میں ثالثی کی درخواست کی تھی۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ امریکا اور اسرائیل کے ساتھ جنگ کے بعد آبنائے ہرمز کی صورتحال پہلے جیسی نہیں رہے گی، اور ایران و عمان اس اہم آبی گزرگاہ کی نگرانی کے حوالے سے ایک نئی مفاہمت پر پہنچ چکے ہیں۔

قالیباف کے مطابق ایران نے آٹھ ماہ سے جاری تنازع کو ختم کرنے کے لیے قطر کے ذریعے امریکا کو ایک سات نکاتی امن منصوبہ پیش کیا ہے اور اب تہران واشنگٹن کے جواب کا منتظر ہے۔ اس مجوزہ منصوبے میں امریکی بحری ناکہ بندی اور اقتصادی پابندیوں کا خاتمہ، ایران کے منجمد اثاثوں کی واپسی، تمام محاذوں پر جنگ بندی اور جنگ کے خاتمے کا باضابطہ اعلان شامل ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ اگر امریکا طے شدہ نکات کی پابندی کرے تو معاہد ممکن ہے، تاہم ایران کو اب بھی امریکی حکومت پر اعتماد نہیں۔

ایرانی اسپیکر نے خبردار کیا کہ اگر امریکا نے ایران کے خلاف دوبارہ فوجی کارروائی کی تو صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کو ایک اور شکست کا سامنا کرنا پڑ سکتا ہے۔ آبنائے ہرمز کے حوالے سے ان کا کہنا تھا کہ یہ جنگ سے پہلے والی پوزیشن میں واپس نہیں آئے گا اور ایران اور عمان اس کی نگرانی کے لیے نئی مفاہمت کے تحت کام کر رہے ہیں۔

یمن کی صورتحال پر بات کرتے ہوئے باقر قالیباف نے کہا کہ کسی بھی بیرونی فریق کو یمن کے تنازع میں مداخلت نہیں کرنی چاہیے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ اگر سعودی عرب اور یمن کی حکومت دونوں ایران سے مدد طلب کریں تو تہران تنازع کے حل کے لیے معاونت فراہم کرنے کو تیار ہے۔

stories.title: Azma Bokhari Challenges Federal Minister Chaudhry Salik to Resign
stories.summary:
A political dispute has intensified in Pakistan as Punjab Information Minister Azma Bokhari publicly urged Federal Minister for Overseas Pakistanis Chaudhry Salik Hussain to step down from his cabinet position. The tensions began after the PML-Q leader accused the Punjab administration, led by Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz, of corruption and funding discrimination. Ms Bokhari criticized Salik for engaging in what she termed hypocritical politics, noting that he continues to demand development funds from the same provincial government he attacks. She also highlighted his failure to respond to a five billion rupee defamation notice issued by the chief minister.

In response, Chaudhry Salik defended his stance and asserted that a verbal attack by Ms Bokhari derailed his efforts to resolve the dispute through intermediaries in the federal cabinet. He complained that neither Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif nor other senior PML-N figures intervened to mediate the conflict. Salik stated that he would contest the defamation suit in court, emphasizing that it is unprecedented for a provincial chief executive to sue someone in such a manner.

The PML-Q currently maintains two ministerial posts, with Salik serving in the federal government and his brother Shafay holding a position in the Punjab cabinet. While Shafay has maintained a cautious approach, the verbal sparring between provincial and federal figures has widened divisions within the ruling coalition. Rana Sanaullah, an aide to the prime minister on political affairs, also remarked that Salik's allegations stemmed from keeping bad company.

This confrontation matters because it highlights deep cracks within the ruling political alliance in Pakistan, potentially threatening governance stability at both federal and provincial levels. The feud underscores the fragile nature of political coalitions when key figures exchange public insults and legal threats. Background details include the historical role of the influential Chaudhry family and previous regional development allocations during the tenure of Parvez Elahi.

As the war of words continues, Salik insists he will not retract his corruption claims, maintaining that his self-respect was damaged by the chief minister's remarks. Meanwhile, PML-N leaders continue to pressure him to either answer the legal notices or vacate his government office to sit on the opposition benches, leaving the future of the coalition alliance increasingly uncertain.

stories.title: Sofia Franklyn Publishes Memoir Detailing 'Call Her Daddy' Departure
stories.summary:
Podcast host Sofia Franklyn has released a 240-page memoir titled 'Daddy Issues', which recounts her high-profile departure from the hit podcast 'Call Her Daddy' and her fallout with co-creator Alex Cooper. The book arrived on Tuesday and revisits the events surrounding their 2020 split from Barstool Sports.

In the memoir, Franklyn claims she received warnings from individuals close to Cooper, including former podcast contributor Muji, also known as Milfhunter. She also alleges that Cooper secured a $20,000 annual pay raise behind her back and attempted to edge her out of the production.

According to Franklyn, their 2020 contract negotiations involved a proposal for a $1 million annual guarantee each alongside an equal revenue split. However, she alleges that Cooper subsequently approached Barstool founder Dave Portnoy with a solo continuity plan and locked her out of their shared social media accounts.

The book additionally touches upon an alleged legal threat involving Cooper's husband, Hollywood producer Matt Kaplan. Representatives for the Unwell Network informed The New York Times that Kaplan had not discussed the book's contents or any plans to pursue legal action against Franklyn's literary agency.

stories.title: Democrat Scott Colom Wins US Senate Seat in Mississippi Upset
stories.summary:
In a historic midterm election upset, Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican incumbent Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi, becoming the first African American elected to the US Senate from the southern state in over 140 years. Major networks projected the victory on Wednesday, eight days after election night, with Colom leading 49.2 percent to 48.7 percent.

The 43-year-old district attorney's victory adds to a sweeping Democratic wave that flipped control of both chambers of Congress and handed President Donald Trump a major political rebuke. Nationally, Democrats successfully flipped eight Senate seats previously held by Republicans, securing 55 seats in the 100-member chamber against 44 for Republicans, with Alaska still undecided.

Senator Hyde-Smith, who had been in office since 2018, conceded the race in a video posted to X, congratulating Colom on taking over the role. Top Democrat Chuck Schumer celebrated the milestone on social media, declaring that "Blue Mississippi is here" and praising Colom's historic accomplishment.

During his victory speech in Jackson, Colom reflected on the state's legacy of Black activism and faith, noting the historical significance of Mississippi electing the nation's very first Black senator, Hiram Revels, during the Reconstruction era following the Civil War.

stories.title: لاہور میں ٹک ٹاک ویڈیو بناتے ہوئے شیرنی کے حملے سے نوجوان جاں بحق
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے کاہنہ میں ایک نجی فارم ہاؤس پر شیرنی کے حملے کے نتیجے میں انیس سالہ کیئر ٹیکر جاں بحق ہو گیا ہے۔ یہ واقعہ گزشتہ روز پیش آیا جہاں نعمان نامی ایک ٹک ٹاکر ویڈیو بنانے کی غرض سے پہنچا تھا۔ اس دوران شیرنی قابو سے باہر ہو گئی اور فارم کے ملازم طلحہ کو شدید زخمی کر دیا۔ زخمی ہونے والے نوجوان کو فوری طور پر طبی امداد کے لیے نجی ہسپتال لے جایا گیا مگر وہ جانبر نہ ہو سکا اور دم توڑ گیا۔ واقعے کے بعد متوفی کی لاش کو پوسٹ مارٹم کے لیے مردہ خانے منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔

ابتدائی طور پر اس خوفناک واقعے کی حقیقت کو چھپانے کی کوشش کی گئی اور شیرنی کے حملے کو آوارہ یا کسی دوسرے کتے کا حملہ ظاہر کرنے کی سازش کی گئی تھی۔ تاہم، مشکوک صورتحال کی باریک بینی سے جانچ پڑتال کی گئی تو اصل حقیقت سامنے آئی اور یہ انکشاف ہوا کہ نوجوان کی موت کتے کے کاٹنے سے نہیں بلکہ شیرنی کے حملے کی وجہ سے ہوئی ہے۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی پنجاب وائلڈ لائف اور کاہنہ پولیس نے فوری طور پر قانونی کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا۔ ترجمان ڈی آئی جی آپریشنز فیصل کامران کے مطابق پولیس نے بریڈنگ فارم کے مالک فیاض عرف فیضی اور ٹک ٹاکر نعمان کو حراست میں لے کر مقدمہ درج کر لیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ حملہ کرنے والی شیرنی کو بھی متعلقہ فارم ہاؤس سے تحویل میں لے کر وائلڈ لائف ڈپٹی حکام کے حوالے کر دیا گیا ہے۔

پولیس اور وائلڈ لائف حکام کی جانب سے فارم ہاؤس میں شیرنی رکھنے کے لیے اجازت نامے، وہاں کیے گئے حفاظتی انتظامات اور ممکنہ غفلت کے تمام پہلوؤں پر تفتیش کی جا رہی ہے۔ ترجمان ڈی آئی جی آپریشنز نے دو ٹوک الفاظ میں بیان کیا ہے کہ ٹک ٹاک کا شوق کسی بھی انسانی جان سے قیمتی نہیں ہو سکتا۔ تفریح یا شوق کی آڑ میں انسانی زندگیوں کو خطرے میں دھکیلنے والے عناصر کو ہرگز معاف نہیں کیا جائے گا اور واقعے کی تمام زاویوں سے مکمل تحقیقات جاری ہیں۔

stories.title: Punjab Government Denies Politics in Smog Crisis as Lahore Suffers
stories.summary:
The Punjab government emphasized that smog and environmental health are urgent scientific challenges rather than political matters, as severe air pollution continued to choke Lahore, Multan, and other regional cities. Senior provincial minister Marriyum Aurangzeb stated during a press briefing that the administration has established a technology-driven monitoring system to track and mitigate pollution sources. On Wednesday night, Lahore recorded an alarming air quality index reading of 358, placing it at the top of global pollution rankings.

According to the Punjab Environment Protection Agency, trans-boundary pollution played a major role in the recent surge of particulate matter. Assessments indicated that roughly half of the province was affected by air carrying heavy pollutants from across the border in India, where Diwali celebrations involved extensive fireworks. Trajectory models showed that air masses could travel from Amritsar to Lahore in approximately two hours. Monitoring stations near the Wagah Border registered a massive spike in fine particulate concentrations, corroborating the impact of easterly winds.

Despite the severity of the crisis, provincial officials reported that current air quality indicators show a marked improvement compared to previous years. Ms Aurangzeb noted that Lahore's air quality index reached a dangerous level of around 2,400 on November 11, 2024, whereas readings remained below 450 on the same date in 2026. She credited this progress to advanced forecasting tools, round-the-clock monitoring, and strict enforcement across industrial, agricultural, and transport sectors. The heavy smog had earlier forced authorities to temporarily close several sections of motorways due to severely reduced visibility.

Across the border, New Delhi faced similar choking conditions with an air quality index of 248, though monitoring instruments were overwhelmed by pollutant concentrations exceeding their design limits. This equipment failure sparked political backlash in India, with opposition figures accusing authorities of data fraud and deliberate shutdowns. However, the Central Pollution Control Board rejected these allegations, explaining that automated systems simply exclude readings that fall outside calibrated operational ranges.

This issue is critical as toxic smog severely threatens public health, agricultural output, and daily economic activity for millions of residents across the region. The crisis underscores the urgent need for cross-border cooperation and sustained institutional efforts to address the root causes of dangerous particulate pollution. Background details reveal that prior to recent policy changes, Punjab lacked an integrated, real-time framework to predict and manage environmental emergencies effectively.

stories.title: Prime Minister Sharif Bans Police Deployment in Islamabad Educational Institutions
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has instituted a complete ban on housing police and security personnel in schools and colleges across Islamabad during law and order situations. In addition, he directed that teachers must be restricted exclusively to teaching duties under all circumstances, exempting them from administrative tasks such as elections and census activities.

The directive emerged from a recent meeting where the prime minister observed that educational facilities and teachers should remain strictly focused on academics rather than operational security. Following this decision, the Prime Minister's Office issued written instructions to the Ministry of Education. On Wednesday, the ministry conveyed the rules to the Islamabad district administration, the capital's police, the chief commissioner, the CDA chairman, the secretary interior, and the Federal Directorate of Education.

The ministry's letter explicitly prohibits using the premises, buildings, classrooms, and facilities of schools and colleges under the Federal Directorate of Education for temporary housing, police deployment, detention facilities, or any operational activities. Furthermore, it mandates the immediate cancellation of any administrative duties previously assigned to teachers. This policy aims to prevent educational disruptions that previously affected thousands of students.

The decision addresses significant educational losses suffered by students in 38 public-sector schools and colleges in the capital. These institutions had faced closures lasting between one to three weeks in September to accommodate law enforcement personnel ahead of an anticipated protest march by the PTI. Government officials and observers have welcomed the ruling as a necessary step to protect students' learning and fulfill long-standing teacher demands.

stories.title: Speaker Sadiq Says Lawmakers Cannot Speak Against State Institutions
stories.summary:
National Assembly Speaker Sardar Ayaz Sadiq stated that while elected representatives have the constitutional right to raise public concerns in parliament, no member will be permitted to use the floor to speak against the state, judiciary, or armed forces of Pakistan. He made these remarks on Wednesday while speaking to reporters in Sahiwal after offering condolences to the family of late former MNA Chaudhry Muhammad Ashraf. 

Highlighting the role of the parliament, Sadiq described the National Assembly as a vibrant forum committed to strengthening democratic traditions, safeguarding parliamentary norms, and ensuring representation for all political voices. He noted that the opposition is provided ample opportunity to express its views, with speaking time increased from eight to thirteen hours on important occasions to ensure broader participation and fairness.

Sadiq also addressed recent political developments, dismissing narratives regarding attempts to oust the government as claims promoted by individuals who failed to secure public support through elections. He emphasized that democratic institutions must be strengthened through constitutional and parliamentary means rather than outside interference.

Paying tribute to the late MNA Chaudhry Muhammad Ashraf, the speaker praised the politician for standing firmly with the PML-N leadership during challenging times. Sadiq's remarks underscore ongoing efforts by the parliamentary leadership to maintain decorum and institutional respect within the legislative body.

stories.title: FBR Deploys AI System to Electronically Scrutinize Tax Returns
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue has broadened the application of artificial intelligence to analyze individual income tax returns. This automated system is designed to identify factual errors, legal mistakes, and data discrepancies before tax authorities take any legal or penal action against taxpayers.

Under the new framework, notified via SRO 2098 of 2026 as amendments to the Income Tax Rules 2002, taxpayers will receive electronic notifications regarding identified discrepancies. The automated system cross-matches information declared in tax returns with other available databases. When issues are flagged, the system generates online advisories or advance intimations through IRIS, which may also be issued directly by the relevant Officer of Inland Revenue.

The notification must specify a response period of at least seven days, allowing taxpayers to provide explanations, correct errors, or resolve discrepancies. If a taxpayer fails to respond within this timeframe, a reminder granting at least seven additional days will be issued. All notices, taxpayer responses, and subsequent actions are tracked on a centralized system dashboard for reference and monitoring.

Once the response period concludes, the designated Officer of Inland Revenue reviews the taxpayer's explanation and assesses the situation. Based on this evaluation, the officer can proceed with appropriate measures under the provisions of the Income Tax Ordinance 2001 and its associated rules.

stories.title: Pakistan Reports $98.07 Billion External Debt and $3.23 Billion Interest Payments
stories.summary:
Pakistan repaid approximately $14.44 billion in external loans during the 2025-26 fiscal year while receiving $16.16 billion in disbursements, primarily aimed at budgetary support, foreign exchange reserves, and currency stabilization. According to the Ministry of Economic Affairs' annual report on Foreign Economic Assistance, the country's total external public debt reached $98.075 billion as of June 30, following fresh financing commitments of $8.951 billion.

The disbursements fell short of the budget target of $19.923 billion by about 19 percent, achieving 81 percent of the projected goal. Total external public debt servicing amounted to $14.436 billion, which included $11.198 billion in principal repayments and $3.238 billion in interest payments. Net transfers totaled $4.417 billion, reflecting a $6.28 billion or 6.84 percent increase in the external public debt stock compared to the $91.795 billion recorded at the end of the 2024-25 fiscal year.

Out of the total disbursements, $9.375 billion was secured for budgetary support and balance of payments. Within this category, Naya Pakistan Certificates accounted for 33 percent or $3.050 billion, time deposits from friendly countries made up 32 percent or $3 billion, foreign commercial banks and bonds contributed 31 percent, and the IMF provided 4 percent. Project financing accounted for $3.435 billion, focusing on sectors such as energy, environment, water, transport, and education, while commodity financing reached $2.019 billion and programme financing stood at $1.329 billion.

Multilateral and bilateral development partners provided $59.931 billion of the overall external public debt. Among multilateral partners, the World Bank led with $2.025 billion, followed by the Asian Development Bank with $1.772 billion, and the Islamic Development Bank with $1.087 billion. Saudi Arabia was the largest bilateral contributor, disbursing $1.013 billion, while China contributed $501 million.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Raises Rs587 Billion in Treasury Bill Auction
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government successfully secured Rs586.7 billion during a Treasury bill auction on Wednesday, significantly surpassing both its initial target of Rs400 billion and the maturing bills amounting to Rs435 billion. According to data released by the State Bank of Pakistan, this total comprised Rs232.46 billion raised through the auction itself and an additional Rs354.25 billion via non-competitive bids. This financial outcome underscores a mounting demand for liquidity by state authorities.

Market participation was notably high, with total cumulative bids from various corporations and commercial banks reaching an impressive Rs2.192 trillion. Investors displayed a clear preference for parking their available capital in secure government instruments. The highest demand was recorded for the 12-month papers, attracting bids totaling Rs676 billion, out of which the administration accepted Rs201 billion, marking the largest accepted amount for any single tenor during the event.

Conversely, other tenors witnessed varied acceptance rates despite heavy interest from financial institutions. The three-month papers drew the second-largest offer at Rs666.3 billion, though authorities raised only Rs19.46 billion. Similarly, bids for one-month papers reached Rs494.7 billion with a modest acceptance of Rs0.5 billion, while six-month benchmark papers brought in Rs355.5 billion in bids against an accepted total of Rs11 billion.

The volume of accepted bids fell considerably short of total bank offers, pointing to broader liquidity within the banking sector. Part of this excess liquidity flowed into the private sector, resulting in improved borrowing metrics during the fifth month of the ongoing fiscal year. Analysts view these dynamics as a reflection of investors seeking safe yields amidst evolving macroeconomic conditions.

stories.title: Karachi Chamber President Urges Unified Platform to Resolve Business Issues
stories.summary:
Karachi Chamber of Commerce and Industry President Talat Mehmood has advocated for the creation of a unified platform uniting five to six prominent trade chambers across Pakistan. Speaking at an Islamabad Chamber of Commerce and Industry event on Wednesday, Mehmood suggested that the proposed forum assemble monthly on a rotational basis to effectively address persistent commercial and industrial hurdles.

Mehmood emphasized that individual representations by separate chambers frequently fail to yield concrete results. In contrast, a consolidated front would command greater influence and credibility when engaging with government authorities. He commended ICCI President Mohammad Zikria Akbar Zia for gathering leading trade bodies onto a single platform and extended an invitation for a reciprocal visit to Karachi.

Highlighting the nation's economic landscape, Mehmood noted that current exports hover around $30 billion while remittances reach approximately $41 billion. He warned against an overreliance on overseas remittances, advising the administration to formulate policies and incentives that stimulate domestic investments by overseas Pakistanis to bolster internal economic activity.

Additionally, Mehmood recommended specific administrative conveniences for the trading community, including dedicated airport counters for investors and traders. He stressed that institutional reforms and digitization should serve to facilitate rather than encumber businesses. In response, ICCI President Zia endorsed tighter coordination among major chambers, reaffirming that collective action remains vital for overcoming commercial obstacles.

stories.title: World Leaders at COP31 Pitch Climate Action to Ease Living Costs
stories.summary:
Leaders attending the COP31 summit in Turkiye are promoting climate action through a new economic lens, arguing that transitioning away from fossil fuels can bolster economies and lower the cost of living. This message aims to capture the attention of governments currently distracted by severe crises, such as rampant inflation exacerbated by disruptions to Middle East crude oil shipments during the Iran conflict. Consumer price pressures on fuel and food previously influenced the US midterm elections and remain critical vulnerabilities for political leaders across Europe, Asia, and other regions.

United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres addressed world leaders on Wednesday, stating that three-quarters of humanity live in fossil-fuel-importing countries that are vulnerable to external price shocks. He emphasized that recent conflicts demonstrate how fossil fuel dependency causes chronic insecurity and cost-of-living crises, with renewable energy serving as the clear remedy. UN climate chief Simon Stiell echoed these sentiments, noting that energy market chaos and climate disasters are supercharging inflation, straining government budgets, and reducing household living standards.

Veteran climate advocate and former US secretary of state John Kerry expressed support for this reframing, pointing out that climate change has become heavily politicized, particularly in the United States where President Donald Trump withdrew the country from international climate cooperation last year. Kerry noted that incorporating security, health, job creation, community stability, and food supply into the conversation addresses issues that are directly on people's minds. While speakers acknowledged that scientific evidence of human-driven warming remains the primary justification for action, European energy commissioner Dan Jorgensen suggested that emphasizing economic and security benefits can help build broader consensus, even among climate skeptics.

stories.title: Three Palestinians Killed in Latest Israeli Strikes Across Gaza
stories.summary:
Recent Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip resulted in the deaths of three Palestinians, including two brothers, according to local health authorities. Medics reported that an initial strike targeted the rooftop of a residential building in Gaza City, killing one man. A subsequent strike hit a tent camp housing displaced individuals in the nearby Sheikh Radwan neighborhood, claiming the lives of brothers Mahmoud and Jamil Al-Absi.

The Israeli military stated that its operations targeted individuals it classified as terrorists in both locations, though it provided no further specifics. These incidents occur against the backdrop of a stalled reconstruction process following a US-brokered ceasefire last year. Negotiators have remained deadlocked over terms concerning the disarmament of Hamas and the withdrawal of Israeli troops, who currently maintain control over roughly two-thirds of the territory from which residents were previously ordered to evacuate.

In Gaza City's Sabra neighborhood, residents surveyed the wreckage of a metal foundry and adjacent tents following a previous strike that killed three people and ignited severe fires. Hisham Abdou, a displaced father of two, recounted losing all personal belongings and shelter in the blaze, noting the psychological toll the destruction has taken on his young children. While Israel asserts that Hamas is actively attempting to rebuild its military capabilities and rearm, Hamas maintains its adherence to the ceasefire framework and accuses Israel of sabotaging the agreement.

Health officials in the territory report that at least 1,600 Palestinians have lost their lives in Israeli attacks since the implementation of the ceasefire. On the other side, official figures indicate that four Israeli soldiers have died during the same timeframe amid ongoing regional volatility.

stories.title: Pakistan Focused on Leveraging Artificial Intelligence for National Growth
stories.summary:
Pakistan is actively working to transform the global artificial intelligence revolution into an opportunity for economic advancement, national development, and technological sovereignty, according to IT Minister Shaza Fatima Khawaja. Speaking during the Margalla Dialogue 2026, she highlighted that emerging technologies are fundamentally altering global employment, education, healthcare, and security systems. She noted projections indicate artificial intelligence will expand into a $4.8 trillion economic sector by the year 2033, impacting roughly forty percent of jobs worldwide.

During the panel discussions, former national security adviser retired Lt Gen Nasser Janjua addressed non-traditional security challenges, advocating for unconventional solutions such as engaging with insurgents in Balochistan and negotiating with Afghanistan. International speakers also shared perspectives, including Prof Cheng Xizhong of China's Charhar Institute, who criticized Indian policies regarding regional stability and water treaties. Meanwhile, Akira Igata from Tokyo University suggested Japan could learn from Pakistan's extensive counter-terrorism experience in managing technology-driven security threats.

Experts at the conference emphasized the importance of data governance and institutional coordination. Dr Rehan Tahir, executive director of the Pakistan Digital Authority, explained that the agency's primary mandate is linking federal and provincial databases to improve service quality and delivery. Additionally, retired Brig Dr Rashid Wali Janjua discussed the changing face of modern warfare, pointing out how precision and speed are increasingly dictated by artificial intelligence applications in military operations.

This dialogue is significant as it outlines Pakistan's strategic roadmap to prepare its workforce and institutional frameworks for a technology-dominated future. It addresses critical intersections between national security, digital infrastructure, and international diplomacy amid evolving global power politics. Background context features previous national initiatives aimed at training millions of digital professionals and expanding the country's technological capabilities.

Concluding the sessions, participants underscored that while rapid technological shifts present severe management challenges and public trust issues in governance, proactive planning can secure long-term economic dividends. The conference served as a platform for regional and international experts to debate the future trajectory of state functionality in an increasingly automated world.

stories.title: Federal Constitutional Court Dismisses Hundreds of Super Tax Review Petitions
stories.summary:
The Federal Constitutional Court has rejected more than 395 review petitions that challenged its prior ruling upholding the constitutional validity of the super tax. In its detailed order issued on Wednesday, the chief justice stated that review jurisdiction cannot be utilized as a substitute for a regular appeal. The court emphasized that a review is strictly limited to correcting manifest errors or patent legal infirmities rather than reopening matters that have already been conclusively decided.

A three-judge bench had previously reserved its verdict on review petitions filed by numerous prominent entities, including major commercial banks, textile mills, fertilizer manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, oil refineries, and cement producers. Notable petitioners included JS Bank, Engro Corporation, Pakistan Petroleum Limited, Lucky Cement, and Meezan Bank, among others. The court reaffirmed its earlier January 2026 judgement, confirming the legal applicability of sections 4B and 4C of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001.

Addressing legislative competence, the bench ruled that the super tax falls under federal legislative powers and was correctly processed as a money bill under article 73 of the Constitution. The court also dismissed objections regarding the retrospective application of tax provisions and upheld income-based classifications under article 25, determining that reasonable fiscal classifications do not violate equality guarantees. Furthermore, the court clarified that following the 27th Constitutional Amendment, it exercises independent constitutional jurisdiction, meaning Supreme Court precedents serve as persuasive rather than binding authority.

This ruling is crucial for the national economy and fiscal policy, as it protects vital government tax revenues and brings legal finality to prolonged financial litigation involving major corporate taxpayers. The decision ensures that existing tax structures and computations under final tax regimes remain legally undisturbed. Background context highlights that the initial litigation involved widespread corporate resistance to tax burdens introduced under specific statutory provisions.

The court concluded that individual tax assessment disputes must be resolved separately through appropriate legal channels rather than through review petitions. With the dismissal of these filings, the original judgement and all associated legal directives remain fully operational across the country.

stories.title: Yemenis in Sanaa Mourn Dozens Killed in Alleged Saudi Strikes
stories.summary:
Large crowds gathered in the Yemeni capital of Sanaa on Wednesday to participate in funeral prayers and mourn dozens of individuals killed in recent strikes attributed to Saudi Arabia. According to the Houthis, a strike on Saturday targeted the village of al-Shariya, situated outside the capital, resulting in 44 fatalities—including 21 children—and leaving 40 others injured. Following prayers at the Mosque of the People, mourners transported the caskets, which featured photographs and names of the victims, to al-Shariya for burial.

The renewed hostilities have intensified the conflict in Yemen, which has faced ongoing warfare since the Houthis seized Sanaa in 2014, prompting a Saudi-led coalition to intervene a year later. A fragile truce from 2022 broke down in July when the Houthis permitted an Iranian plane to land in the capital. The United Nations reports that ongoing fighting since the summer has displaced over 300,000 people and killed more than 1,600 individuals across the country.

Alongside the funeral proceedings, security developments unfolded in multiple regions on Wednesday. Yemeni security sources reported Houthi missile and drone strikes targeting camps associated with forces fighting the Houthis in Aden, the seat of the internationally recognized government. Meanwhile, the Saudi-led coalition stated that its air defences intercepted three Houthi cruise missiles launched toward the Riyadh region, marking the second consecutive day of such interceptions.

The escalation highlights a worsening humanitarian and security crisis in Yemen, compounding years of devastation and regional friction. As casualties continue to mount from cross-border attacks and domestic clashes, the resumption of widespread fighting underscores the persistent fragility of peace efforts in the region.

stories.title: AJK Leaders Call for Restraint and Peace Amid Ongoing Unrest
stories.summary:
Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) President Dr Muhammad Najeeb and Prime Minister Iftikhar Gillani urged the public to exercise restraint, peace, and historical awareness during a seminar in Muzaffarabad. The event was organised by the Sudhan Educational Conference to mark the anniversary of Col Khan Muhammad Khan, also known as Baba-i-Poonch, and Captain Muhammad Hussain Shaheed.

PM Gillani highlighted that irresponsible and provocative discourse on social media was disrupting ordinary lives, preventing children from attending school and patients from reaching hospitals. He noted that while governance shortcomings may exist, chaos is not the appropriate response, warning that certain individuals are exploiting public sentiments for personal agendas. He stressed the importance of maintaining state authority, noting that peace is vital for a region with a development budget of Rs32 billion and favorable infrastructure and literacy rates.

President Najeeb observed that social media has blurred the line between truth and falsehood, making it essential to teach younger generations about national heroes and the history of the freedom movement. He recalled the sacrifices of Baba-i-Poonch and Capt Muhammad Hussain Shaheed in establishing the Azad Government on October 24, 1947, and building educational and health facilities. AJK Legislative Assembly Speaker Chaudhry Tariq Farooq, former presidents Sardar Masood Khan and Sardar Yaqoob Khan, MNA Sher Afzal Marwat, Sudhan Educational Conference President Sardar Shazib Shabbir, and MLA Sehrish Qamar also spoke at the seminar.

The leadership's appeals come amid recent unrest in the region, which the AJK government reported has resulted in seven law enforcers martyred, alongside criticisms regarding the disproportionate use of force that deepened local polarization.

stories.title: چترال میں بارش اور پہاڑوں پر برفباری سے سردی بڑھ گئی
stories.summary:
چترال کے مختلف علاقوں میں رات تین بجے سے شروع ہونے والی بارش اور پہاڑوں پر ہلکی برفباری نے موسم کو انتہائی سرد بنا دیا ہے اور ہوا میں خنکی میں نمایاں اضافہ ہو چکا ہے۔

بالائی چترال کے مختلف مقامات سمیت لواری ٹنل، کریم آباد، سوسوم، کالاش ویلیز، مدکلشٹ اور گرم چشمہ کے بالائی علاقوں میں بارش اور پہاڑوں پر برفباری ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔

موسم کی اس اچانک تبدیلی اور شدید سردی کے باعث شہریوں کو گھروں کو گرم رکھنے کے لیے جلانے کی لکڑی کے حصول میں شدید مشکلات کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔

سوختنی لکڑی کی قیمتوں میں ہوشربا اضافے کے ساتھ ساتھ گیس سلنڈر بھی عوام کی پہنچ سے باہر ہو گئے ہیں، جس سے اس سرد موسم میں مقامی شہریوں کی مشکلات میں مزید اضافہ ہو گیا ہے۔

stories.title: ایف بی آر نے انکم ٹیکس گوشواروں کی خودکار جانچ پڑتال نافذ کر دی
stories.summary:
وفاقی حکومت نے انکم ٹیکس رولز 2002 میں نئی شق 38 بی شامل کرتے ہوئے انکم ٹیکس گوشواروں کی خودکار جانچ پڑتال کا نیا طریقہ کار متعارف کرا دیا ہے، جس کا فیڈرل بورڈ آف ریونیو (ایف بی آر) نے نوٹیفکیشن جاری کر دیا ہے۔
